title: Simple Bacteria Genetic Engineering
summary: The Thought Emporium shows how easily bacteria can be genetically modified to produce fluorescent proteins and even bioluminesce, with techniques doable at home. It links to companion videos on incubators, DNA extraction and gels.
why: HN points to it as proof that DIY genetic engineering is feasible and as an example of a rigorous hands-on biology channel.

quote.text: he makes videos about DIY genetic engineering and I have a huge amount of respect for his rigor and detail
